title: Just-in-time permission requests
summary: Ask for protected capabilities when a user initiates a feature that needs them, with a clear explanation of value and fallback.
problem: Permission prompts during startup lack context, reduce trust, and can block later functionality after an uninformed denial.
use_when: A feature requires a protected platform or account capability
avoid_when: The product can provide value without the capability and the user has not expressed intent to use the dependent feature
rationale: Context helps users understand why access is requested.
Denial should lead to a recoverable path rather than a dead end.

use_if: A feature requires a protected platform or account capability
prefer_alternatives_if: The feature can work with manual input or a less sensitive capability

requirements: Explain the purpose in ordinary text before or around the platform prompt when needed.
Provide a keyboard and screen-reader reachable recovery path after denial.
Request only the minimum capability needed.
Trigger the request from an understandable user action.
Explain how to recover after denial when the platform allows it.
